name: The Wave (Coyote Buttes North)
why: Across open sand and slickrock with no marked path to a swirl of striped sandstone, one of the most photographed rocks in America.
book: Permit only, by lottery on recreation.gov: advance lottery four months ahead, or the daily mobile lottery two days before (only near Kanab or Page). 64 people a day. Wire Pass trailhead on House Rock Valley Road (dirt, impassable when wet).
dangers: No trail: carry the BLM route photos and a GPS; people get lost.
Deadly heat in summer: hikers have died on the way back.
House Rock Valley Road floods after rain.
turnaround: Start back from The Wave by 13:00 in the warm months.

points.name: Wire Pass trailhead
points.note: Parking on House Rock Valley Road with the permit register.

points.name: The Wave
points.note: Bands of red and white sandstone curving like a frozen wave.
